Below is the text of DeepSeek's API pricing page.

Report the peak pricing rule exactly as THIS PAGE states it. Do not use anything you already
know about DeepSeek's pricing. If this page disagrees with what you remember, the page wins.

Two fields:

  quote     Copy, word for word, the part of the page that says which days the peak rule
            applies to. Use the page's own wording. Do not paraphrase it, do not tidy it up,
            and do not answer this field with a bare list of day names.

  days      The weekdays the rule applies to, derived FROM THE QUOTE ABOVE - not from memory,
            and not from what is usual for this kind of product - as three-letter
            abbreviations from ["Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun"]. If the quote says
            the rule applies every day, list all seven.

Reply with one JSON object, and nothing else - no prose and no markdown fences.
